title: feat(studio): Restore package original moves onto the override mark, in a popover that names what it overrides and its version
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPFUgboizUXWX8RQ7py6Pfk)_

Fixes #29692

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 里「覆盖 XX」标记变成按钮,点开小气泡:写明覆盖了哪个包、基于哪个版本,底部是「恢复包原版」,仍走原来的确认框。各条目 ⋯ 菜单里的「恢复包原版」去掉,只剩这一个入口;「自定义」保留标题行主按钮位。
- **为什么改**:ADR-0146 D2 要求恢复入口放在点名定制的地方;原来要在 ⋯ 菜单里找,且标记本身不说明基于哪个版本。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 app-shell 前端;恢复请求与原来逐字节相同(先删草稿,再删行,都带 `package=` 配对包),无元数据、接口和 i18n 键变化。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`(`StudioOverrideChip` 气泡)、`StudioItemHeader.tsx`(折进 ⋯ 菜单后,恢复时关掉菜单)、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` / `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`(去掉菜单项、接上 `onRestore`)。
- **两分钟验证**:窗口 1024 px、右侧面板打开,在 Studio 打开一个已定制的视图:⋯ → 点「覆盖 …」→ 气泡里有版本句和「恢复包原版」→ 弹出确认框,菜单已关。键盘:⋯ 上 Enter,再 Enter 打开气泡,焦点在「恢复包原版」。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The override mark is the door.** `StudioOverrideChip` ("Overrides HotCRM") is now a popover trigger. The popover (`studio-override-popover`) names the package it overrides and the version it was taken from (the existing `overridesTitle` sentence, which was the chip's tooltip), and holds **Restore package original** (`studio-override-restore`). Restore goes through the existing confirmation dialog, and confirming sends the same two deletes at the pair as before: its draft, then its row. Without `onRestore` (a declaration served while the item is not in the pair) the popover shows the facts only.
- **Every type that draws the mark gets it:** Interfaces views, dashboards and reports (the item header), an object leaf's list view, flows (Automations), and the All-metadata form editor (`StudioBundleItemEditor`). Customize keeps the header's primary slot; Restore is never a header button of its own.
- **One door.** The ⋯-menu Restore entries (`studio-restore-original`) come out of the Interfaces item menu, `FlowItemMoreMenu` (its `restore` prop is gone) and the bundle editor's menu. Each host's `inPair` is `declaration !== null`, so everywhere Restore was reachable the mark is drawn and carries it.
- **Folded into the ⋯ menu** (#29693's header fold): the mark sits in the one `studio-item-header-folded-chips` entry. Its popover is a child of that menu item in React's tree, so pointer, click and key events inside it stop at the popover. Otherwise a pointer moving over the popover focused the menu item and closed the popover. Restore there closes the ⋯ menu before the confirmation opens (`useStudioFoldedMenuClose`), so no hidden menu is left behind the dialog to take the next Enter.
- `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx`: the sentence that sent the reader to the ⋯ menu now points at the mark.
- No new i18n keys and no changed en values.

## Tests

- `StudioCustomizeControls.customize-28562.test.tsx`: the chip's facts are on the popover; Restore asks once and closes; a disabled Restore asks nothing; without `onRestore` the popover is facts only.
- `StudioItemHeader.titleRowFold-12897.test.tsx`, new describe for the folded mark: one press opens one popover and the menu stays, a second press closes it; Enter on the folded entry opens it; Restore asks once and closes both the popover and the menu; a pointer moving and pressing inside the popover neither focuses the entry nor closes the popover.
- `InterfacesPillar.customize-28562.test.tsx`, `AutomationsPillar.customizeFlow-28570.test.tsx`, `StudioBundleItemEditor.customize-28569.test.tsx`: Restore is driven from the mark and the existing `resets` assertions (same two requests at the pair) still hold; the ⋯ menus carry no `studio-restore-original`; the dialog's item label equals the rail row's label (Interfaces "Pipeline", flow "Notify owner").
- `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts`: the Restore step presses the mark in the row, or in the folded ⋯ entry when the row has folded, then the popover's Restore.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- At head 9403cae2: the five touched test files plus `itemTools-28239` and `oneSurface-28572`, 7 files, 112 tests passed.
- Ablation of the two folded-menu fixes, one at a time, restored to the committed blob: dropping the popover's event stops reds the pointer pin (1 failed, 20 passed); dropping the menu close reds the Restore pin (1 failed, 20 passed).
- app-shell `type-check` (src and tests) exit 0; `type-check:e2e` exit 0; eslint on the touched files 0 errors.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed, 2 skipped. `check:type-check-debt` exit 0. `check-i18n-en-drift`: no en value changed.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 67 derived, 67 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check-sdui-manifest` exit 0.
- Merged `main` right before opening (14 incoming commits, none touching these files; no parallel fix found).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Dialog label (任务清单 vs "Task List"): not reproducible on this tree. In zh the view leaf's dialog says 「任务清单」, as its header and rail row do; in en it says "Task List". The dashboard reads 「图表画廊」, the object leaf's list view 「全部任务」, and the flow "Notify on Task Completed", matching its zh rail row (the flow has no translation). Pinned in tests against the rail label.
- At about 1024 px with the right panel open every header folds, so the folded state was measured there and the row state at 1440 px with the panel open (object leaf list view).
- The live journey spec passes with `--timeout=180000` (41.6 s); under the default 30 s test timeout it runs out in the later "Add region__c" step on a Vite dev Console, after Restore has passed.

## Verification

Live on the showcase app (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) with the Console on Vite, Chromium, right panel open, overrides drafted in the pair for a view, a dashboard, a flow and an object's list view. For each, by mouse and by keyboard, at 1024 px (folded) and 1440 px:

| Item | Header | Mouse | Keyboard |
|---|---|---|---|
| View (Task List) | folded at 1024 and 1440 | popover stays open under the pointer, exactly one, menu stays under it; Restore opens the dialog and the menu is gone | Enter on ⋯ focuses the folded entry, Enter opens the popover with focus on Restore, Enter opens the dialog |
| Dashboard (Chart Gallery) | folded at 1024 and 1440 | same | same |
| Flow (Notify on Task Completed) | folded at 1024 and 1440 | same | same |
| Object list view (All Tasks) | folded at 1024, row at 1440 | same | same |

Screenshots (en and zh) are with the seat.
